title: Usage event ingestion leakage
trigger: Usage-based billing depends on event streams that are late, duplicated, rejected, or missing idempotency controls.
decision_insight: Run event-level completeness checks before invoice preview and revenue accrual decisions.
recommended_action: Add usage-event reconciliation, exception queue aging, and rejected-event remediation to the handover heatmap.

title: Billing primitive mismatch
trigger: Pricing model requires dimensional usage, composite pricing, prepaid credits, or enterprise-specific contract logic beyond the selected billing primitive.
decision_insight: Assess whether the billing stack can represent commercial terms without spreadsheet overrides or manual invoice adjustments.
recommended_action: Create a pricing-complexity fit test for billing-system readiness scoring.

title: Async invoice preview mismatch
trigger: Usage ingestion and invoice preview run asynchronously, causing decisions to rely on incomplete or stale usage state.
decision_insight: Separate operational invoice readiness from revenue estimate readiness when async usage processing is material.
recommended_action: Add async processing latency and post-preview usage delta checks to model assumptions.

title: E-invoice data completeness failure
trigger: Structured invoice, VAT, timing, or bank-detail fields are incomplete for jurisdictions moving toward digital reporting.
decision_insight: Treat international e-invoice readiness as a billing-data design question, not only a tax compliance question.
recommended_action: Add jurisdictional structured-invoice field mapping to handover readiness packs.

title: ACH fraud-monitoring blind spot
trigger: Payment operations do not reflect 2026 ACH fraud monitoring or company entry description rule changes.
decision_insight: Include ACH monitoring, statement descriptor logic, and return-code routing in billing operations diligence.
recommended_action: Add ACH rule-readiness checkpoints to payment operations heatmap rows.

title: Audit-evidence package gap
trigger: Management dashboards, AI outputs, reconciliations, or system reports cannot be traced to audit-ready evidence packages.
decision_insight: Evidence packaging should be a first-class product output for high-risk handover scenarios.
recommended_action: Add evidence-package quality, lineage, reviewer signoff, and retained-source checks to the model.

title: Intersegment pricing pressure transfer
trigger: Internal pricing, rebates, or allocation adjustments improve reported segment performance without supportable market terms or evidence.
decision_insight: Segment and intercompany adjustments can move leakage from operations into reporting, disclosure, and audit risk.
recommended_action: Add intersegment pricing and unsupported adjustment tests to disclosure-control risk scenarios.
